mini_task_spec:
Using the `estimate` tool (chars/4 heuristic for code, integer/floor division), compute the estimated token count for each of the 13 TypeScript files located **directly** inside `test-repo/packages/common/interfaces/` (i.e., at the root of that directory only — not in any subdirectory, `maxdepth 1`). List all 13 files sorted by descending estimated token count. Report as a table with two columns: `file` (path relative to `test-repo/`) and `tokens` (integer, floor(char_count / 4)). Also report the total estimated tokens across all 13 files.
